'''Jan Siwanowicz''' of Warsaw, Poland, was the random-draw winner of Puzzle 1 of the 1997 Dagobah Contest, from 933 correct entries.<ref name="sol1">[http://rothko.decipher.com/new/dagobahcontest/solution1.html The Dagobah Contest], Decipher (17 March 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19970327214330/http://rothko.decipher.com/new/dagobahcontest/solution1.html Internet Archive]</ref>
